limitations: The default binding mode at the binding is the relevant condition. Earlier editions document different allowances.
Reference patterns with & or &mut and explicit binding modifiers are separately handled.

triggers: Material correction of the referenced rule, applicability, or edition scope.

statement: In Rust 2024, a binding pattern can explicitly use ref, ref mut, or mut only when the default binding mode at that binding is move.
